title: refactor(objectql): move the last 28 hand-series private docblocks out of engine.ts with the codemod's third pass (slice 2 of 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1KEKUvnWZ8oYQ388cWv3dF)_

Fixes #30053

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：第二片，也是最后一片。用 #30341 里加的 `--hand-docs`（不带 `--modules`）在 `main` `38717d34` 上生成：其余 10 个手写模块的 28 块私有 docblock（858 行）从 `engine.ts` 搬到函数上。`engine.ts` 12,618 → 11,752 行。生成物未手改，脚本本片未改。另把 liveness 台账 `query.groupBy` 一行的证据改指 `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts#aggregate`。
- 为什么改：维护者在 #30012 上说「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」。两片合计搬走 64 块 1,787 行，`engine.ts` 从 13,550 行降到 11,752 行。
- 风险与回滚：只搬注释。撤销证明逐字节还原 base；公有 `.d.ts` 相等；objectql 测试 base 550 文件 / 10,967 = head；回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① `engine.ts` 顶部被剪掉的 4 个 import 绑定；② `query.json` 的 `groupBy` 一行（第一片时 `searchFields` 的同类问题见 #30367 / #30368，这次 `check:liveness` 进了门禁清单，推前已过）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --hand-docs --verify --base 38717d34`，应看到 `28 moved (858 lines) across 10 module(s), 36 already moved at base`、`12618 -> 11752 lines`，退出码 0；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` 退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：改动共 1,875 行（未超 3,000 行线），本 PR 保持草稿，按席位安排落地。

## What changes

- **The generated slice.** `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --hand-docs --write` on `main` `38717d34`, unedited. With no `--modules` it moves every remaining private hand-series docblock; the 36 the first slice moved are skipped as already moved. The script is unchanged since #30341.
- **Four import bindings pruned** from `engine.ts`, because a moved docblock's `{@link}` was their only reader (`noUnusedLocals` counts a link): `RELATION_FILTER_ID_CAP` (its whole `import { type … }` goes), `resolveFilterTokens`, and `collectInternalReadFields` / `collectCredentialFields` (their whole import goes).
- **`packages/spec/liveness/query.json`, row `query.groupBy`.** The third leg cited `engine.ts#aggregate`; the body has lived in `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` since the codemod split, and the last mention of `groupBy` in `engine.ts`, a private docblock, moved in this slice. The leg now cites `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts#aggregate`, and the note gains one dated sentence. Without it `check:liveness` reds exactly as it did after the first slice (#30367).
- **Changeset.** `patch` on `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/spec` (the ledger ships in the spec package).

### What moved in this slice (10 modules, 28 docblocks, 858 lines)

| Hand module | Docblocks | Lines | Before → after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `engine-driver-options.ts` | 6 | 148 | 403 → 550 |
| `engine-hook-dispatch.ts` | 4 | 147 | 240 → 388 |
| `engine-file-reference-hydration.ts` | 5 | 128 | 453 → 581 |
| `engine-referential-integrity.ts` | 2 | 123 | 232 → 358 |
| `engine-execute-transactions.ts` | 2 | 73 | 204 → 280 |
| `engine-query-lowering.ts` | 3 | 69 | 178 → 249 |
| `engine-realtime-publish.ts` | 2 | 66 | 518 → 587 |
| `engine-count-aggregate.ts` | 1 | 41 | 209 → 254 |
| `engine-validation-messages.ts` | 2 | 40 | 193 → 236 |
| `engine-reference-name-visible.ts` | 1 | 23 | 238 → 265 |

`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: 12,618 → 11,752 lines.

### After both slices

All 64 private hand-series stubs that had a docblock now keep it beside their body. On the class stay: the 20 public stubs (their docblock is the contract), `validationMessageContext` (its function already carries a richer docblock; merging two is an edit, not a move) and `noteAdmittedValueShapeViolation` (no docblock). `--hand-docs` on this head plans 0 moves.

## Verification

All at head `cc44c59f` unless stated.

- **Proof.** `--hand-docs --verify --base 38717d34`: exit 0. `28 moved (858 lines) across 10 module(s), 36 already moved at base; engine.ts 12618 -> 11752 lines; undoing every move rebuilds the base, undone the same way, for engine.ts and its 21 hand module(s) byte-for-byte, once the 4 import binding(s) only a moved docblock linked are pruned`.
- **Determinism.** The same `--write` on a stale checkout of `main` (`f672e0dc`, the same `engine.ts` and hand modules) printed the same output tree sha256 `6c71d47c…7b38` as the run on `38717d34`.
- **`.d.ts`.** `packages/objectql/dist` built at base `38717d34` twice and at head twice. Base 1 = base 2 and head 1 = head 2, byte for byte. Base against head: `core` and `index` (`.d.ts` and `.d.mts`) are byte-identical; `util-HASH` has 193/193 statements and 334/334 private members, and its public surface is **EQUAL**. The raw difference is the 858 lines of moved private docblocks.
- **Ablation (on the real tree).** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob: one character changed in a moved docblock (`inAfterAbortUnit`'s, in `engine-hook-dispatch.ts`) → `--verify` exits 1 naming the line; one character changed in a docblock that stays on the class (`checkDriversHealth`) → exits 1 naming the line. The battery's own ablations ran on #30341 and the script is unchanged; `--self-test` 105 cases pass.
- **Suites.** objectql `test`: base `38717d34` 550 files / 10,967 passed, head 550 / 10,967. objectql `typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Liveness.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: exit 1 before the `groupBy` repoint (only that row), exit 0 after. Separately, all 36 ledger rows that cite `engine.ts` were read: each one's key (camelCase or snake_case) is still named in `engine.ts` on this head.
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 62 commands (`check:liveness` among them), each run after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` (exit 0). All 62 exit 0; `--ran`: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- As in the first slice, `{@link}`s inside a moved docblock now sit in the hand module and are not rewritten.
- The `protocol.ts` half of #30053 (157 stubs, about 4,000 lines) is not in this card's claim. The seat files it separately once its own serial constraints clear.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (a ledger row only)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (the designated thread branch, recreated from `main`; second of two slices)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (a liveness row; nothing generated reads it)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
